item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows Krish's 5-by-3 grid of unit squares. He wants to cover it with 2-by-1 tiles. Tiles must not overlap and must not leave gaps.

Can the grid be tiled?

options.A: No. The grid has 15 unit squares, so 2-by-1 tiles cannot cover it.
options.B: The tiling decision is the label "unit squares" on the grid.
options.C: Yes. Any block of 15 cells can be paired into 2-by-1 tiles.
options.D: Pairing tiles along rows is what creates the 5-by-3 grid size.
